definitions.baseline: Exact retained stage6 engine 108d4725; retained gzip, not Git HEAD.
definitions.minimumGap: Minimum sampled actual ball/selected receiver centre gap from release until resolution; acquire hook samples before normal first-touch impulse. A swept physical contact can occur between frames, so centre gap at acquisition can exceed1.10m.
definitions.resolvedTargeted: Pass-kind flights with an intended recipient that resolve by actual acquisition, boundary restart, goal, replacement or flight clearing. Pending window-end flights are excluded from intended-miss denominators.
definitions.ownLastTouchOut: Targeted flight directly resolving in throw/goal-kick/corner while passing team made last contact. It is not inferred from absence of opponent possession.
definitions.receiverInterceptionKinds: Resolved targeted ordinary pass and cutback flights. Through/cross/long-pass flights remain separately counted; this label does not infer whether a particular planner branch was invoked.
definitions.receptions: Real successful same-team pass-family acquisitions, including other-own recipients, are recorded only after acquire returns true. Intended prepared acquisitions require the actual target plus the same valid preparation condition as acquire (matching flight ID, age below0.55s). Planned mode comes from the pre-acquire plan; actual mode, ball impulse, body and clocks are observed after the untouched engine method returns.
definitions.groundFacing: Actual successful acquisitions by the intended non-goalkeeper with a matching preparation below0.55s old on ground pass/cutback, outside restart contexts. Contact geometry is derived from actual ball/player pose before acquire: gap<=1.20m, forward>=-0.18m, absolute lateral<=1.00m. These are physical foot-window counts at actual acquisition, not a promise that a subsequent control/pass succeeds. Each window denominator includes elapsed and pending cases separately. Unlike whole-match flight categories, this subgroup checks the actual narrow facing conditions at contact.
definitions.actualMode: The post-acquire receiveMode is recorded without inferring success. Current cushion mode is a fallback after a real body/swept interception when the ball is outside the existing deliberate foot-contact geometry; it retains the ordinary cushioning impulse, clears the quick prepared action, and requires normal movement to recover. This label is not a completed deliberate touch or proof of improved possession.
definitions.rapidTurnover: Each actual reception opens overlapping one-second and two-second observation windows. Opponent acquisition means a later successful actual acquire by the other team within1s or within2s; opponent restart is recorded separately and is not silently counted as an acquisition. Elapsed without opponent acquisition does not imply continuous ownership: loose balls and own passes may occur. Pending end-of-window cases are reported separately; no success is imputed. Pressured means nearest current opponent is less than3m at acquisition.
definitions.existingFlight: Fork snapshots may already contain a released pass. Its releaseObserved is false; its sampled gap starts at the fork, not original release.
definitions.limits: Small synthetic sample, no win target, ball/receiver repositioning, RNG forcing, hidden opponent commands or future plans. Tactical changes and preparation timing may diverge after the shared starting state.

prefix: Complete exact retained stage6 engine from initial kickoff to selected time, with the recorded config. Both branches receive identical complete state and RNG.
